weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; 4 stale facility portal accounts; dispatcher role left with a former dispatch cover
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist covering platform, facility portal, suite, phone, and devices; monthly reconciliation; yearly facility user confirmation; remove stale facility accounts and the leftover dispatcher role
milestones: 2026-08-19 stale facility accounts disabled; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Office Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Shared dispatch account on the dispatch desktop and the on-call phone
remediation_plan: Named dispatch accounts with the platform's quick sign-in; retire the shared account; interim password change and weekly export check
milestones: 2026-09-08 shared password changed; 2026-10-31 named accounts live and shared account disabled

weakness: No MFA on platform administrator accounts or any platform user; backup console and firewall login accept a password alone
remediation_plan: Enable platform MFA for every user (authenticator app on company phones and tablets); MSP enables MFA on the backup console and firewall and sends screenshots
milestones: 2026-09-30 MFA on backup console and firewall; 2026-10-31 platform MFA for all users

weakness: No time limit for disabling access; shared credentials and codes not changed; no exit reminder of confidentiality
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (same as POAM-001) with credential and code changes and a signed confidentiality reminder; per diem accounts disabled after 60 idle days

weakness: Dispatch desktop never locks and faces the front door
remediation_plan: Turn the dispatch screen away from the door; privacy filter; 10-minute quick re-sign-in once named accounts exist (documented equivalent measure)
milestones: 2026-09-15 screen moved and filter fitted; 2026-10-31 quick re-sign-in

weakness: Training only at hire and privacy only; no reminders, phishing exercises, or training on recording and the AI assistant
remediation_plan: Annual online training with security content; quarterly phishing simulations; monthly reminder; recording announcement and AI intake training for the Scheduler-Dispatcher
milestones: 2026-09-30 AI intake and recording training; 2026-10-31 first annual training; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: No audit log or access report review; unexplained exports found only by the assessor
remediation_plan: Weekly export log check; monthly 30-minute review of the access report and suite sign-in alerts with a checklist; findings to the Owner
milestones: 2026-09-08 weekly export check starts; 2026-10-31 first monthly review
resources_required: Office Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: No single inventory; vehicle hotspots and trackers on no list
remediation_plan: One-page device and ePHI inventory with owner, location, and ePHI fields; hotspots added and handed to MSP management; quarterly review
milestones: 2026-10-31 inventory complete; 2026-12-31 hotspots under MSP management

weakness: No contingency testing: no restore test and no manual dispatch drill
remediation_plan: MSP restores a sample folder and one full mailbox; quarterly restore tests recorded; quarterly manual dispatch drill using the printed run sheet; annual tabletop using the P08 runbook
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-10-31 first manual dispatch drill; 2026-11-30 tabletop; 2026-12-31 second restore test
resources_required: MSP labor (about 2 hours a quarter); staff time

weakness: Backups not immutable; one MSP login without MFA can delete them; paper BAAs and PCS binder not backed up
source: P07; P01 R-005, R-012; P04 finding 2
remediation_plan: 90-day versioning with immutable retention; MFA on the console (POAM-003); scan BAAs and the PCS binder into the platform and shared drive
milestones: 2026-09-30 BAAs scanned; 2026-10-31 backup upgraded; 2026-12-31 PCS binder scanned

weakness: Phone vendor without a BAA at assessment; AI feature terms unreviewed; no vendor oversight
remediation_plan: Phone BAA (done 2026-08-21); written confirmation that the platform BAA covers the AI feature with no-training terms, or switch the feature off; annual MSP and billing company reviews; platform SOC 2 review (done 2026-08-26)
milestones: 2026-08-21 phone BAA; 2026-08-26 SOC 2 review; 2026-10-15 AI feature confirmation; 2026-12-31 MSP and billing company reviews

remediation_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption; monthly encryption status in the MSP report

weakness: Antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours; no behavior-based detection
remediation_plan: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alert monitoring on the 3 computers; alerts also texted to the Office Manager and the Owner; false-positive procedure
resources_required: About $900 a year plus the after-hours line

weakness: Unmanaged remote desktop tool on the dispatch desktop; no software restrictions
remediation_plan: Tool removed (2026-08-19); approved software list enforced by the MSP; only the MSP's managed remote tool allowed (POL-02 B.9); monthly new-software report
milestones: 2026-08-19 tool removed; 2026-10-31 approved software list enforced
